The table does not provide particle size and release mechanism for the SPIONs carrier. However, the text does: 

SPIONs exhibit superparamagnetic properties within specific size ranges and have been utilized as siRNA delivery vehicles. For example, Hu et al. [99] developed PEN-coated SPIONs (CNP@siSnail2) targeting Snail2. Upon intravenous injection, CNP@siSnail2 passively extravasates and accumulates within tumor tissues through the EPR effect, facilitating efficient delivery of siSnail2 to tumor cells. Both in vitro and in vivo studies demonstrate that CNP@siSnail2 significantly downregulates Snail2 expression, thereby inhibiting EMT as well as tumor cell migration and invasion.
